declarations.description:
Warning at the bottom of the screen: `<c-alert-banner>Gamepad getrennt</c-alert-banner>`;
`raised` sits above a banner that is already there.
declarations.name: CAlertBanner

declarations.description:
`<c-button label="Zurück" mode="cancel" size="l" compact></c-button>`; `active` marks the
option currently selected with keyboard, gamepad or phone.
declarations.name: CButton

declarations.description:
A live camera picture of 16:9 that keeps its place while the page around it is redrawn: `<c-camera-view mirrored></c-camera-view>`.
The scanner writes the stream into `video`; `mirrored` flips the picture like a mirror, the way a front camera is expected to look.
declarations.name: CCameraView

declarations.description:
Card of one lobby slot with the cat view: `<c-cat-preview-card variant="player" color="#e0533d">
<c-player-tag>…</c-player-tag> <c-preview-frame>…</c-preview-frame> …</c-cat-preview-card>`.
`color` sets the border of a player card.
declarations.name: CCatPreviewCard

declarations.description: `<c-checkbox label="Ton" ?checked=${on}></c-checkbox>`; the native `change` event bubbles up.
declarations.name: CCheckbox

declarations.description:
Small status label: `<c-chip mode="success">Bereit</c-chip>`. `mode="color"` paints it in
`color` (a player colour); `dim` fades it, `outlined` adds a ring (e.g. a locked-in vote).
declarations.name: CChip

declarations.description: Drawn gamepad overview: `<c-controls-guide></c-controls-guide>`.
declarations.name: CControlsGuide

declarations.description:
The same cross on every phone screen that is not the race: four arrows around a round OK. Keys that do nothing on the
current screen stay where they are but are dimmed and disabled, so the thumb always finds the same place.
`<c-dpad up="on" down="on" left="dim" right="dim" ok="on" ok-label="Zurück"></c-dpad>`. The buttons have the ids
`pad-up`, `pad-down`, `pad-left`, `pad-right` and `pad-ok`; the controller script binds them by screen.
declarations.name: CDpad

declarations.description:
`<c-header level="2">Titel</c-header>`; level 1 (the default) is the largest, `tone="muted"`
greys it out (e.g. an empty slot).
declarations.name: CHeader

declarations.description: Container of the race HUD in the top left corner; on phone widths it spans the full width.
declarations.name: CHud

declarations.description:
Race status of one player: `<c-hud-card color="#e0533d" place="1/4" status="Runde 1/3" item="Haarball"
.notes=${['→ Start/Ziel']}></c-hud-card>`.
declarations.name: CHudCard

declarations.description: Time box of the HUD: `<c-hud-timer>0:03.22</c-hud-timer>`; `mode="alert"` is the red finish countdown.
declarations.name: CHudTimer

declarations.description:
List of rows or cards: `<c-list direction="row" gap="m">…</c-list>`; `inset` pads it inside a
card, `align="center"` centres mixed children vertically, `reserve` keeps room for one
line even when empty.
declarations.name: CList

declarations.description:
One row of a `<c-list>`; children are laid out left to right, the last one pushed right.
`active` marks the keyboard/gamepad selection, `interactive` makes it clickable.
declarations.name: CListItem

declarations.description:
Full-screen loading screen with a cat kart driving on the spot: `<c-loading-screen
label="Naturpfad wird geladen" tip="…"></c-loading-screen>`. `leaving` fades it out.
declarations.name: CLoadingScreen

declarations.description:
Card of the map vote: `<c-map-vote-card><c-preview-frame …/><c-header level="3">Name</c-header>
<c-list …>markers</c-list></c-map-vote-card>`.
declarations.name: CMapVoteCard

declarations.description:
One card of the memory board: `<c-memory-card face="🐟" label="Fisch" state="open" cursor="#e0533d"></c-memory-card>`; `cursor` is the colour of the
player who points at it (empty for nobody). A face down card shows a question mark and never its face.
declarations.name: CMemoryCard

declarations.description: Dimmed full-viewport layer that centres its content above the page: `<c-modal><c-panel>…</c-panel></c-modal>`.
declarations.name: CModal

declarations.description: Boxed surface for grouped content, e.g. inside a modal: `<c-panel>…</c-panel>`.
declarations.name: CPanel

declarations.description:
Frame rate in the bottom left corner, always on top: `<c-perf-readout headline="24 FPS" tone="slow"></c-perf-readout>`.
`tone="slow"` marks a frame rate below the target; the numbers carry the meaning, the colour only underlines it.
declarations.name: CPerfReadout

declarations.description:
Coloured label bar at the top of a player's card: `<c-player-tag color="#e0533d">Rußpfote</c-player-tag>`.
`selected` marks it as the row the cursor is on: the name can then be changed with left/right.
declarations.name: CPlayerTag

declarations.description:
Frame for a live preview canvas that the game mounts into it:
`<c-preview-frame size="map" data-map-preview-index="0"></c-preview-frame>`.
declarations.name: CPreviewFrame
qrModulePath

type.text: { readonly path: string; readonly size: number }

declarations.description: Black modules of the code as one SVG path, so it stays sharp at any size.

A QR code, always black on white with its quiet zone (cameras need it): `<c-qr-code value="…" label="…"></c-qr-code>`.
It fills the width of its parent up to 22rem and stays square; `large` lets it use half the screen height instead of 40 percent.
declarations.name: CQrCode

declarations.description: One line of the result table: place, cat name in its player colour, finish time and the points (this game and the total).
declarations.name: CResultRow

declarations.description:
Full-screen overlay surface that centres its children (and scrolls when they are taller than the screen): `<c-screen tone="solid">…</c-screen>`;
`enter` flies it in when it appears.
declarations.name: CScreen

declarations.description:
Scrollable, left-aligned area for long content inside a menu: `<c-scroll>…</c-scroll>`. The scrollbar is always
visible so that cut-off content shows there is more to scroll to.
declarations.name: CScroll

declarations.description:
One selectable setting in a card: label on the left, value (optionally with colour swatches)
on the right, and ◀/▶ arrows while it is the active row.
`<c-setting-row label="Fellfarbe" value="Schwarz" .swatches=${['#000']} active></c-setting-row>`
declarations.name: CSettingRow

declarations.description:
Layout primitive that lines its children up: `<c-stack direction="row" gap="m" align="center">…</c-stack>`.
`grow` takes the free space of its parent, `fill` the whole viewport, `narrow` a phone-width column, `wrap` lets the children flow onto the next line,
`adapt` changes the layout with the orientation (`rowInLandscape`, `columnInPortrait`, `centerInPortrait`,
`tightInPortrait`). `fill` follows the visible height of a phone browser (dvh), not the one behind its toolbars.
declarations.name: CStack

declarations.description: Big centred "3", "2", "1", "Los!" before the race: `<c-start-countdown>3</c-start-countdown>`.
declarations.name: CStartCountdown

declarations.description:
Small comparison bars in two columns, e.g. the driving values of a kart:
`<c-stat-bars .bars=${[{ label: 'Tempo', ratio: 0.6 }]}></c-stat-bars>`
declarations.name: CStatBars

declarations.description:
Touch stick area of the phone controller. The controller script drives `#stick-knob` and
`#stick-line`, grabs fingers on `#stick-zone` and measures `#stick-base`; the knob and line take
the player colour from the page's `--player-color`.
declarations.name: CStickPad

declarations.description:
Paragraph text: `<c-text tone="muted" size="s">…</c-text>`; `relaxed` adds line spacing for
multi-line explanations, `measure="prose"` limits the line length. Links inside are styled too.
declarations.name: CText

declarations.description:
Big touch button of the phone controller: `<c-touch-button kind="action" mode="warn" size="l"
label="Drift"></c-touch-button>`. `kind` is the shape: arrow keys, round action buttons or the
small round system buttons, `ok` the round confirm button in the middle of the arrows. `aria` sets the accessible name for icon-only labels.
declarations.name: CTouchButton
